description: National Renewable Energy Laboratory (NREL), US, Annual Technology Baseline (ATB) is a data resource listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Technology assumptions > National Renewable Energy Laboratory (NREL), US, Annual Technology Baseline (ATB)", published or maintained by atb.nrel.gov (publisher inferred from the link). Last updated October 2018. "The ATB represents a populated framework to identify technology-specific cost and performance parameters or other investment decision metrics across a range of resource characteristics, sites, or fuel price assumptions for electricity generation technologies both at present and with projections through 2050.". Coverage: as stated on the linked page. The openmod wiki page "Technology assumptions" lists it under "National Renewable Energy Laboratory (NREL), US, Annual Technology Baseline (ATB)". It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the wiki page (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source.
